title: senna surattensis subsp. retusa
intro: Senna surattensis subsp. retusa, commonly known as Senna retusa or Chinese senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including constipation, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of being a natural laxative and anti-inflammatory agent. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting digestion, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sennosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Senna retusa are responsible for its therapeutic effects, including sennosides, which are responsible for its laxative properties.
